name: Kami (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kami town emblem in green, light blue and blue: a green disc with a light blue sail above blue waves.
history: Municipal flag of Kami, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 July 2005.

features.role: Kami town emblem — a green disc with a light blue sail above blue waves
